info.title: Circaevum Garmin queries
info.description: Run these operations with Test Request on Developers & Agents. The request paths identify browser operations routed through the signed-in Circaevum account frame. Standalone HTTP clients cannot call these paths. The account frame uses the signed-in session automatically.

post.description: Read the signed-in account’s selected window from Nakama. The dates describe stored summaries and the events identify records with timeline geometry. Daily summary coverage can include dates with no heart-rate samples.

200.description: Summary dates, timeline events, Garmin User IDs found in storage, and any incomplete read.

post.description: Inspect recent receiver-wide delivery counts. Sleep pushes report accepted.sleeps. A ping can have a separate ping_processed entry. Written and failed count storage outcomes across that delivery.

200.description: Receiver delivery timestamps, modes, summary counts, and storage outcomes.

post.summary: Read backfill history and Garmin User IDs
post.description: List the authenticated account’s logged Garmin backfill requests and linked Garmin User IDs when exposed by the receiver. Use Check stored summaries to look up IDs from existing records.

200.description: Backfill requests and any linked Garmin User IDs.

post.description: Submits a backfill request for the linked account. Garmin delivers accepted requests asynchronously. Check the journal for delivery and stored summaries to confirm the selected record reached Nakama.

200.description: Garmin accepted the request or reported an existing request for this window.

409.description: The account does not have a usable Garmin connection.

502.description: The receiver could not complete the Garmin request.

end.description: End in Unix seconds, inclusive. Must follow start and span at most 24 hours.

InvalidWindow.description: Invalid summary type or timestamp window.

SignIn.description: Sign in to Circaevum in this browser.
